title: Drone Roof Nonrenewal Defense Kit
oneLiner: A homeowner evidence workspace for fighting insurance roof flags from drone, satellite, or virtual inspections.
targetUser: Homeowners, recent homebuyers, insurance agents, roofers, and family members helping someone respond to repair-demand or nonrenewal letters.
keyUx: The homeowner enters the insurer notice, roof age, inspection deadline, photos, roofer letters, and recent repairs; the app builds a response timeline, evidence checklist, contractor packet, and appeal letter.
requiredUiSections: Notice intake with cancellation, nonrenewal, repair-demand, and premium-hike modes
Roof evidence locker for photos, receipts, permits, inspection reports, and roofer letters
Aerial-image challenge checklist for outdated imagery, moss/staining, false positives, and repaired issues
Contractor visit planner and quote comparison

externalSignalRefs.source: Reddit r/homeowners, virtual/drone insurance inspection fear
externalSignalRefs.observed: Homeowners fear virtual or drone inspections will misread roof condition and trigger repair demands or cancellation.

externalSignalRefs.source: Kiplinger, insurers using drones and satellite imagery
externalSignalRefs.observed: Insurers increasingly use aerial images for underwriting, renewals, and claims, often before homeowners know there is a problem.

stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype for "Drone Roof Nonrenewal Defense Kit," a homeowner evidence workspace for responding to insurance roof flags from drone, satellite, or virtual inspections. Include: notice intake, deadline and coverage-risk header, roof evidence locker, aerial-image challenge checklist, contractor visit planner, insurer response letter composer, agent/regulator escalation tracker, and shareable packet export. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with reassuring household-finance surfaces, legible deadline states, plain-language evidence cards, restrained urgency colors, and a guided document flow; it should feel protective and competent for a homeowner under pressure.
